properties_the_panel_states: The array only grows. Nothing is deleted. Nothing is rewritten.
A pointer references earlier entries in the same array.
A pointer is also a section of Lace. It can be referenced by later entries.
Words and pointers are both entries.
3D (and higher) views are projections, not storage.

slot order is chronological -- 4 of 6 pointers have ref_A later than ref_B
slot order is reverse-chronological -- 0002 and 0006 have ref_A earlier than ref_B
